newsitem.title: USA: Hertz Technology unaware of reason for drop.
newsitem.headline: Hertz Technology unaware of reason for drop.

text.p: Hertz Technology Group Inc said Monday it was not aware of any reason for the decline in the price of its common stock.

Hertz Technology, a builder and seller of computer equipment, said the shares' closing price of $1.31 on Friday was significantly below the company's tangible net worth reported in its May 31 10-QSB financial statement.
Eli Hertz, chairman, president and chief executive officer, told Reuters, "The company's shareholder equity on May 31 was roughly $6,596,000, with 3,165,000 shares outstanding.
"There is no reason for our stock, from an operations point of view, to have dropped to this level from its initial public offering price of $5 a share last November." he said.
The stock was up 9/16 at 1-7/8 this morning.
